The club participated in [[2025–26 Ligue 1|Ligue 1]], the [[2025–26 Coupe de France|Coupe de France]], the [[2025 Trophée des Champions|Trophée des Champions]], the [[2025–26 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]], the [[2025 UEFA Super Cup|UEFA Super Cup]] and the [[2025 FIFA Intercontinental Cup|FIFA Intercontinental Cup]]. PSG became world champions for the first time when they won the [[FIFA Intercontinental Cup]], defeating [[CR Flamengo|Flamengo]] of Brazil on penalties in the [[2025 FIFA Intercontinental Cup final|final]] on 17 December 2025. They also accomplished the rare [[sextuple (association football)|sextuple]], as this was their sixth trophy won in the same calendar year.{{cite web |last=Bernal |first=Rodrigo |title=Paris Saint-Germain and Luis Enrique Make History With a Sextuple |url=https://www.beinsports.com/en-us/soccer/fifa-intercontinental-cup/articles/paris-saint-germain-and-luis-enrique-make-history-with-a-sextuple-2025-12-17 |date=17 December 2025 |access-date=21 December 2025 |website=beIN SPORTS |quote=Paris Saint-Germain are no longer chasing history: they have written it. With their victory over Flamengo in the Intercontinental Cup final, the Parisian club completed the long-awaited sextuple, a feat reserved only for the most dominant teams of all time.
